messages.content: aaj ka din ajeeb guzra. subah gas nahi thi, bijli bhi gayi, aur bus bhi miss ho gayi

Subah se hi gas, bijli aur bus, teeno ek saath ulat gaye, to din shuru hone se pehle hi thakan ho gayi hogi. Aise din mein chhoti cheezein bhi bohat bhari lagne lagti hain. Is waqt sab se zyada kis baat ka bojh mehsoos ho raha hai?
bas yeh ke office late pohncha to boss ne sab ke saamne tok diya

Yani subah ki saari pareshani ke baad office mein sab ke saamne toka jana, woh bhi un cheezon ki wajah se jo kisi ke bas mein nahi theen. Sab ke saamne tokna aksar sharminda bhi karta hai aur ghussa bhi dilata hai. Us lamhe andar kya mehsoos hua?

messages.content: ghar ka kaam, bachon ki parhai, saas ki dawai ka time, sab mujh par hai. dimagh har waqt chalta rehta hai

Ghar, bachon ki parhai aur saas ki dawai ka hisaab, sab kuch ek hi dimagh mein chal raha ho to yeh thakan samajh aati hai. Lagta hai jaise chhutti ka koi lamha hi nahi bachta, kyun ke kaam ki fehrist kabhi khatam nahi hoti. Din mein koi waqt hota hai jab yeh sab thora sa ruk jaye?
raat ko sab so jate hain tab. lekin tab bhi kal ka sochti rehti hoon

Matlab jab ghar khamosh hota hai tab bhi dimagh kal ka hisaab lagane mein laga rehta hai, aur jo waqt sirf apna hona chahiye woh bhi kaam mein chala jata hai. Kabhi kabhi soch ko kaghaz par utaar dena dimagh ko thora halka kar deta hai, kyun ke phir use yaad rakhne ka bojh nahi rehta. Raat ke us khamosh waqt mein aap ke liye sukoon ka matlab kya hoga?

messages.content: ammi ne phir rishte wali aunty ko bulaya hai sunday ko. main abhi tayyar nahi hoon

Sunday ko rishte wali aunty aa rahi hain aur andar se abhi is ke liye tayyari nahi, yeh beech mein phansne wali kaifiyat hai. Ammi ki koshish ek taraf hai aur aap ka apna waqt doosri taraf. Tayyar na hone ke peeche kya hai, parhai, kaam, ya kuch aur jo abhi dil mein hai?
job abhi lagi hai, pehle khud ko settle karna hai. lekin ammi kehti hain umar nikal jayegi

To asal baat yeh hai ke nayi job hai aur abhi apne qadam jamana zaroori lag raha hai, jab ke Ammi ki fikar umar ke baare mein hai. Dono baatein apni jagah sachi hain, aur yahi is ko mushkil banata hai. Kya Ammi ko kabhi khul kar bataya hai ke settle hone ka matlab aap ke liye kya hai?
nahi, darr lagta hai woh naraz hongi ya rone lagengi

Ammi ke naraz hone ya rone ka darr itna bara hai ke baat shuru karna hi mushkil lagta hai. Yeh darr is baat ki nishani bhi hai ke un ke jazbaat aap ke liye kitne ahem hain. Aksar maa baap ki fikar ke neeche pyaar hota hai, aur kabhi kabhi seedhi baat sun kar woh utna naraz nahi hote jitna hum soch lete hain. Agar baat karni ho to kis lamhe mein Ammi sab se zyada sunne ke mood mein hoti hain?

messages.content: shadi ko chhe mahine hue hain. susraal mein har cheez mein galti nikalti hai, khana ho ya kapre

Chhe mahine mein har din kisi na kisi cheez par galti nikalna, khana ho ya kapre, yeh dil ko bohat thaka deta hai. Naye ghar mein jagah banana waise hi mushkil hota hai, aur upar se yeh toka taki. Sab se zyada kis ki baat chubhti hai?
nand ki. saas to phir bhi kabhi kabhi tareef kar deti hain

Yani saas se kabhi kabhi tareef bhi mil jati hai, lekin nand ki baatein zyada gehri lagti hain. Kabhi kabhi hum apni umar ke kisi qareebi insaan se zyada umeed rakhte hain, is liye us ki baat zyada dukhti hai. Nand ki kaunsi baat ya andaaz sab se zyada chubhta hai?

messages.content: abbu chahte hain main CSS karun jaise chacha ne kiya. mera dil software mein hai. har baar baat chhirti hai to ghar mein khamoshi ho jati hai

Ek taraf Abbu ka CSS wala khwab aur chacha ki misaal hai, doosri taraf aap ka dil software mein hai, aur beech mein woh khamoshi jo har baar ghar mein phail jati hai. Aisi khamoshi kabhi kabhi jhagre se zyada bhaari lagti hai. Software mein aisa kya hai jo aap ko apni taraf kheenchta hai?
